parameters.question: Apply 2D MDS (random_state=42) to z-score standardized gene expression data with known groups; report the between-group to within-group Euclidean distance ratio in the 2D embedding and the stress value sqrt(sum((d_orig - d_mds)^2) / sum(d_orig^2)). The output must contain both Stress and Between_Within_Ratio values, and each must agree with the reference within about 5%. Differences in label names and whitespace are acceptable.
